quality_contract: Annotate each state transition from arrived raw dialogue: add, update, withdraw, reopen or no change. Keep the full expected after-state for review, while training the tracker to emit only the supported patch.
Preserve scope, conditions, exclusions, quantities, units, ownership and adoption status. A local change must retain unrelated requirements; a conditional requirement can already be active.

Provide evidence for the entire written operation, including antecedents, preserved qualifiers repeated in replacement text and explicit acceptance of an assistant proposal. A valid source index alone does not establish support.
Include unchanged and ambiguous turns, rejected suggestions and composite changes. Do not force every turn into an update or silently promote a tentative possibility into an adopted requirement.

Inject missing intentions, wrong values, wrong owners, wrong certainty, mistaken withdrawals and stale active cancellations. Repair against original evidence, preserve correct fields, and assess the complete resulting state.

Separate related scenario families across splits; inspect paraphrases and shared specific conditions as well as exact duplicates. Keep source revisions, disagreements, author/reviewer identities and file hashes.
review_and_leakage_note: Every family and fault has a separate model semantic review, with an additional root review for two replaced training scenarios. Retained targets received 108 citation-only corrections. Independent fresh reviews fixed 10 training labels and 40 development/test items before freezing. Cross-split inspection identified two concrete train/test overlaps; those training scenarios were replaced and reviewed again. Short authoring templates and reuse of older exposed rules remain. This is synthetic, model-reviewed data, not human gold.

limits: 500 updates are a bounded pilot budget, not an established sufficient training-data size.
Mostly six to seven events, five decisions per family; no long natural dialogue or own-state rollout validation.
A real-data extension should sample consented representative interactions and obtain human adjudication of ambiguity; no such human data is claimed here.
The current runtime records active, uncertain and withdrawn intentions; tool receipts do not automatically prove task completion.
